# #756 — pre-commit hook lints scratch copies, so .oxlintrc.json path overrides never apply (443 false no-console errors on the reformat commit)

State: OPEN
Author: rodaddy
Labels: none
Created: 2026-08-25T13:41:24Z
Updated: 2026-08-25T13:41:24Z

---

Agent-filed (open-brain head session, 2026-08-25, #750 sprint). Found when the State 5 reformat commit was rejected.

## Measured (RUNNING)

`_githooks/pre-commit` copies staged content to `$scratch_root/pre-commit-staged-$$/<path>` (line 186) and lints the copies with `--config "$ROOT/.oxlintrc.json"`. The config's path-scoped overrides are relative globs (`scripts/**/*.ts` → `no-console: off`, `src/logger.ts` → `no-console: off`, `.oxlintrc.json:138-174`). They do not match the scratch path, so the hook applies the base rule set to files the config exempts.

```
bunx oxlint --no-ignore --deny-warnings --config .oxlintrc.json scripts/bulk-import.ts
  -> 0 no-console findings
cp scripts/bulk-import.ts <scratch>/scripts/bulk-import.ts
bunx oxlint --no-ignore --deny-warnings --config .oxlintrc.json <scratch>/scripts/bulk-import.ts
  -> 5 no-console findings
```

On a commit staging all 533 code files (the #750 reformat attempt), the hook reported 725 errors; 443 were `no-console`, every one a false positive by the same mechanism. The real pre-existing count on those files is 282.

## Consequence

Any commit that touches a `scripts/*.ts` file with console output, or `src/logger.ts`, is refused by the hook for a rule the repo config turns off on that path. The `**/*.test.ts` override still matches because of its leading `**/`; the two bare relative globs do not.

## Fix

Make the copied tree and the config agree on relative paths: copy `.oxlintrc.json` into `$scratch` and run oxlint from `$scratch` with the relative staged paths, or rewrite the overrides to `**/scripts/**/*.ts` form. RED-first: a test in `tests/enforcement.test.ts` that stages a `scripts/x.ts` containing `console.log` and proves the hook accepts it, seen failing before the fix.

Out of #752's count (those are real findings); in #750's enforcement-floor scope.
